title: The integer slice property passes to weak limits in ℝ^P, from CL_P(d) with d + 1 < P (parent V4(ii))
statement: Assume (MR) and (IMC) (types of the accepted cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure and cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub). Let P, d ∈ ℕ with d + 1 < P and assume CL_P(d) (as in sibling boundary_im: weak limits in open U ⊆ ℝ^P of IM d-currents with locally bounded M_W(T_j) + boundaryMassOn(T_j, W) are IM). A current Y ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) has the integer slice property ISP if for all admissible representations (μ, ξ) of Y and (μ', ξ') of ∂Y (Borel measures finite on compacts, a.e. strongly measurable fields with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| a.e., representing the currents on all test forms) and every Lipschitz f, for a.e. t ∈ ℝ every pair of currents A, B with A(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ and B(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ' has ∂A − B IM. Then SLIM_{P,d}: if X_i ⇀ X in 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P), every X_i has ISP and sup_i(M_W(X_i) + M_W(∂X_i)) < ∞ for every open W with compact closure, then X has ISP.
